data.description: Two non-blocking findings from the AS-2 QA review (qa-priya): (1) store.markRead accepts an upTo watermark beyond the current max message id — should clamp or reject; (2) CLI 'chat history @identity' and 'chat read @identity' get-or-create the DM conversation row on what should be a pure read. Neither violates any AS-2 acceptance criterion; both are small correctness/hygiene fixes in apps/chat/lib/store.js and apps/chat/bin/chat.js.
data.title: Chat app: tighten markRead bounds + make CLI reads side-effect-free

data.body: Planning pass done (cto-owen). Verified against current master: BOTH original qa-priya findings still real. (1) markRead accepts upTo > max message id — poisons the watermark irreversibly via the MAX() upsert; only reachable caller-supplied surface is POST /api/read. Decision D1: REJECT (StoreError, in-tx), not clamp — over-max upTo is always a caller bug since message ids are insert-only monotonic. (2) resolveConv still openDm-creates DM rows on history/read/reply @refs (the createDm flag is dead code); since AS-5 this is also an export-churn bug (phantom dm-*.jsonl), and since AS-8 dmConversationFor is the ready-made pure lookup. NOT real: no CLI command mutates read_state as a side effect — inbox/history are already non-mutating; read/catchup mutate explicitly (that IS delivery). D2 records delivery semantics as status quo, binding. Export invisibility of read_state confirmed (export.test.js:80). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M185QACGZFPZ50Z7TV6SBR3P.md. Baseline suite 85/85 (needs NODE_OPTIONS=--no-warnings on node 24 — 2 stderr-strict tests else trip on the node:sqlite ExperimentalWarning; environmental, pre-existing, out of scope, watch for recurrence).
